With a rich history dating back to its Aboriginal origins and its subsequent settlement in the mid-19th century, Coorparoo offers a unique blend of the past and the present, making it an exciting destination for travelers.

The Coorparoo clan lived south of the Brisbane River, and the area was known for its frequent corroborees, traditional gatherings featuring music and dance, along the banks of Norman Creek. name: 'Shells on the Bay'........Right on the foreshore!
description:

neighborhood_overview:
Manly is a very small community with a great village feel and situated right on the foreshore of Moreton Bay. On the weekends there are markets, Sundays see old and young sailors racing radio controlled yachts from the marina wall. You will be surprised who you can meet here.
Cyclists traverse the roads, boardwalks and cycling paths, you can ride for many kilometres in total safety.
Walkers are prolific from dawn to dusk, take a walk up the hill to the Great Wall of Manly, a 'depression work project' created to employ men after the war and funded by the Australian Government.
Travel to the many Islands within Moreton Bay by ferry or water taxi, there is so much to do you won't be bored.
And to top it all off, if you are here for a regatta or sailing event, you will not find a B&B closer to the Royal Queensland Yacht Squadron. It's a very short walk (only minutes), we know because we do it all the time.
host_about:
Shelley & I love to entertain and setting up this B&B has been exciting for us. I have a hospitality background as part of my life and Shelley is fantastic with detail and taking care of people.
We are very active, love sailing, camping, cycling, dancing and skiing.  Our knowledge of where to go and what to do is reasonably extensive as we are well travelled and have a broad knowledge of Australia.
We know Moreton Bay and it's many islands first hand, (we sail on it) and can direct guests to may interesting destinations.  Our membership of the Royal Queensland Yacht Squadron will give you an opportunity to sail on the bay as  our guest if that is something you would love to do.

We are  just a stone's throw away from the  upmarket James Street Precinct, which offers unforgettable wining and dining experiences within renowned and quaint little cafes, restaurants, and bars; shopping havens of boutique clothing stores and a real relaxed and happy vibe from the locals and travellers that keep Fortitude Valley feeling very different from the fast-paced, city-atmosphere of the Brisbane CBD.

Come and enjoy your holiday within your choice of our select, modern and very comfortable apartments that we offer for stays from 2 nights right up to several months! Unfortunately, we don’t offer permanent leasing.

Car parking for one vehicle is provided free of charge - if you do require another carpark we may be able to arrange this at an extra $25 weekly charge, provided we have the availability to do so. Visitors can make use of the Secure Parking below us, where the rates for visitor parking are displayed at the entrance boom gate.

We offer unlimited and free Wifi (100Mbps typical evening speeds) with a private Netflix account ready to be used!

Our guests are welcome to make use of the Pool and BBQ Recreational deck on Level 3 - please let me know if you would like to use some pool towels!

I hope to welcome you soon!

Kindest regards,
Coby Lee Beel  |   Apartments on Connor

host_about:
Hello and welcome - I hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you in one of my 11 listings here in Fortitude Valley! 

My name is Coby - I am a licensed real estate agent and the owner of my small, sole trader business Apartments on Connor, which I began in May 2020.  

I take great pride in my business and I hold myself to the highest of standards, through personally cleaning each apartment myself and ensuring the presentation is a welcoming, inviting and special one. It’s important to me to have happy guests that feel appreciated and valued; I want my guests to enjoy their stay and I’m more than happy to go out of my way to provide a great experience. If you’re here for a special occasion I want to know about it!

Our location is a top feature among guests - each listing is situated within the predominantly residential M&A building on Connor Street, within walking distance to everywhere you could hope to visit within this exciting Brisbane suburb. 

We are  just a stone's throw away from the  upmarket James Street Precinct, which offers unforgettable wining and dining experiences within renowned and quaint little cafes, restaurants, and bars; shopping havens of boutique clothing stores and a real relaxed and happy vibe from the locals and travellers that keep Fortitude Valley feeling very different from the fast-paced, city-atmosphere of the Brisbane CBD.

Come and enjoy your holiday within your choice of our select, modern and very comfortable apartments that we offer for stays from 2 nights right up to several months! Unfortunately, we don’t offer permanent leasing.

Car parking for one vehicle is provided free of charge - if you do require another carpark we may be able to arrange this at an extra $25 weekly charge, provided we have the availability to do so. Visitors can make use of the Secure Parking below us, where the rates for visitor parking are displayed at the entrance boom gate.

We offer unlimited and free Wifi (100Mbps typical evening speeds) with a private Netflix account ready to be used!

Our guests are welcome to make use of the Pool and BBQ Recreational deck on Level 3 - please let me know if you would like to use some pool towels! 

If you have a pet that you just can’t leave behind, don’t fret - you may be able to bring your bundle of fluffy joy with you! A select few of our apartments are 'small dog' friendly, providing some requirements are met - please ask me about these requirements if you would like to know more! 

I am very much a ‘dog person’ and believe in giving back to those who need it most. $2 from every guest stay is donated to Bali Animal Welfare Association to help fund the incredible work the BAWA team do, rescuing and protecting the genetically unique Bali Dog and being the saviour to all animals in need, in Bali. I sell not-for-profit jewellery by BAWA’s founder Janice Girardi which 100% of the proceeds go straight to BAWA - get in touch if you would like to see the range while you are here! 

You can reach me on my mobile 24/7 and I am always more than happy to assist our guests where possible to make their stay enjoyable and fondly remembered. I live in the building too, and am never far away should you need my help at all throughout your stay.

I hope to welcome you soon!

Kindest regards,
Coby Lee Beel  |   Apartments on Connor

name: Valley Apartment - Balcony, Wi-Fi & Free Parking
description:
This Level 4, 1 Bedroom dog-friendly* apartment has everything that you will need to make it your home-away-from-home and your go-to holiday to the city! This self-contained, 56 sqm, private apartment is located within a mostly residential apartment building in Fortitude Valley, just a 5 min walk from the James Street Precinct and right at the heart of Brisbane's Entertainment District.

*Up to two small dogs under 15 kgs are welcome provided they meet our pet-stay requirements.
host_about:
Hello and welcome - I hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you in one of my 11 listings here in Fortitude Valley! 

My name is Coby - I am a licensed real estate agent and the owner of my small, sole trader business Apartments on Connor, which I began in May 2020.  

I take great pride in my business and I hold myself to the highest of standards, through personally cleaning each apartment myself and ensuring the presentation is a welcoming, inviting and special one. It’s important to me to have happy guests that feel appreciated and valued; I want my guests to enjoy their stay and I’m more than happy to go out of my way to provide a great experience. If you’re here for a special occasion I want to know about it!

Our location is a top feature among guests - each listing is situated within the predominantly residential M&A building on Connor Street, within walking distance to everywhere you could hope to visit within this exciting Brisbane suburb. 

We are  just a stone's throw away from the  upmarket James Street Precinct, which offers unforgettable wining and dining experiences within renowned and quaint little cafes, restaurants, and bars; shopping havens of boutique clothing stores and a real relaxed and happy vibe from the locals and travellers that keep Fortitude Valley feeling very different from the fast-paced, city-atmosphere of the Brisbane CBD.

Come and enjoy your holiday within your choice of our select, modern and very comfortable apartments that we offer for stays from 2 nights right up to several months! Unfortunately, we don’t offer permanent leasing.

Car parking for one vehicle is provided free of charge - if you do require another carpark we may be able to arrange this at an extra $25 weekly charge, provided we have the availability to do so. Visitors can make use of the Secure Parking below us, where the rates for visitor parking are displayed at the entrance boom gate.

We offer unlimited and free Wifi (100Mbps typical evening speeds) with a private Netflix account ready to be used!

Our guests are welcome to make use of the Pool and BBQ Recreational deck on Level 3 - please let me know if you would like to use some pool towels! 

If you have a pet that you just can’t leave behind, don’t fret - you may be able to bring your bundle of fluffy joy with you! A select few of our apartments are 'small dog' friendly, providing some requirements are met - please ask me about these requirements if you would like to know more! 

I am very much a ‘dog person’ and believe in giving back to those who need it most. $2 from every guest stay is donated to Bali Animal Welfare Association to help fund the incredible work the BAWA team do, rescuing and protecting the genetically unique Bali Dog and being the saviour to all animals in need, in Bali. I sell not-for-profit jewellery by BAWA’s founder Janice Girardi which 100% of the proceeds go straight to BAWA - get in touch if you would like to see the range while you are here! 

You can reach me on my mobile 24/7 and I am always more than happy to assist our guests where possible to make their stay enjoyable and fondly remembered. I live in the building too, and am never far away should you need my help at all throughout your stay.

I hope to welcome you soon!

Kindest regards,
Coby Lee Beel  |   Apartments on Connor

Hello and welcome - I hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you in one of my 11 listings here in Fortitude Valley! 

My name is Coby - I am a licensed real estate agent and the owner of my small, sole trader business Apartments on Connor, which I began in May 2020.  

I take great pride in my business and I hold myself to the highest of standards, through personally cleaning each apartment myself and ensuring the presentation is a welcoming, inviting and special one. It’s important to me to have happy guests that feel appreciated and valued; I want my guests to enjoy their stay and I’m more than happy to go out of my way to provide a great experience. If you’re here for a special occasion I want to know about it!

Our location is a top feature among guests - each listing is situated within the predominantly residential M&A building on Connor Street, within walking distance to everywhere you could hope to visit within this exciting Brisbane suburb. 

We are  just a stone's throw away from the  upmarket James Street Precinct, which offers unforgettable wining and dining experiences within renowned and quaint little cafes, restaurants, and bars; shopping havens of boutique clothing stores and a real relaxed and happy vibe from the locals and travellers that keep Fortitude Valley feeling very different from the fast-paced, city-atmosphere of the Brisbane CBD.

Come and enjoy your holiday within your choice of our select, modern and very comfortable apartments that we offer for stays from 2 nights right up to several months! Unfortunately, we don’t offer permanent leasing.

Car parking for one vehicle is provided free of charge - if you do require another carpark we may be able to arrange this at an extra $25 weekly charge, provided we have the availability to do so. Visitors can make use of the Secure Parking below us, where the rates for visitor parking are displayed at the entrance boom gate.

We offer unlimited and free Wifi (100Mbps typical evening speeds) with a private Netflix account ready to be used!

Our guests are welcome to make use of the Pool and BBQ Recreational deck on Level 3 - please let me know if you would like to use some pool towels! 

If you have a pet that you just can’t leave behind, don’t fret - you may be able to bring your bundle of fluffy joy with you! A select few of our apartments are 'small dog' friendly, providing some requirements are met - please ask me about these requirements if you would like to know more! 

I am very much a ‘dog person’ and believe in giving back to those who need it most. $2 from every guest stay is donated to Bali Animal Welfare Association to help fund the incredible work the BAWA team do, rescuing and protecting the genetically unique Bali Dog and being the saviour to all animals in need, in Bali. I sell not-for-profit jewellery by BAWA’s founder Janice Girardi which 100% of the proceeds go straight to BAWA - get in touch if you would like to see the range while you are here! 

You can reach me on my mobile 24/7 and I am always more than happy to assist our guests where possible to make their stay enjoyable and fondly remembered. I live in the building too, and am never far away should you need my help at all throughout your stay.

I hope to welcome you soon!

name: Stylish unique haven in vibrant area with pool
description:
A peaceful luxury retreat in the heart of the action. A quiet, leafy, freshly built studio apartment with a stylish pool. Located in an affluent, lively and safe inner city suburb of the tropical capital Brisbane. Walking distance from cafes, restaurants, Suncorp stadium and public transport. Offers a unique tree house style loft bed to delight children and working space for business travellers.
The guest suite is attached to a quaint period home surrounded by luxurious gardens and trees.
neighborhood_overview:
Passionate antique hunter and coffee connoisseur, start with a gourmet cappuccino and croissant 100m from the house and take a stroll down Latrobe Terrace to galleries, op shops, cafes and restaurants, enjoying the stunning views.

Mad for footy or concerts, walk 20 min (1.5km) to Suncorp stadium and the famous Caxton street. This state of the art stadium seats 52,000 people and is home to the Reds, the Broncos and the Socceroos. Also check their calendar for world class music performers.

15 min walk down the hill, you will find Rosalie Village with amazing delicatessen, boutique wine bar, park and playground.

Here for business, you will be in the city in 15 min with 3 bus options (stops 200m from home) and can work quietly in the studio. Take away dinner options are on the way back from the bus stop.

Family gateway to sunny Queensland, enjoy the pool and entertainment area with darts and mini table tennis. Delight your kids with a tree house
host_about:
We look forward to hosting you and giving you a unique experience that will make you love our little corner of paradise. We moved here from Paris years ago and can’t wait for you to discover why we enjoy Paddington and its community so much.
Language spoken: English and French

host_about:
Hello and welcome - I hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you in one of my 11 listings here in Fortitude Valley! 

My name is Coby - I am a licensed real estate agent and the owner of my small, sole trader business Apartments on Connor, which I began in May 2020.  

I take great pride in my business and I hold myself to the highest of standards, through personally cleaning each apartment myself and ensuring the presentation is a welcoming, inviting and special one. It’s important to me to have happy guests that feel appreciated and valued; I want my guests to enjoy their stay and I’m more than happy to go out of my way to provide a great experience. If you’re here for a special occasion I want to know about it!

Our location is a top feature among guests - each listing is situated within the predominantly residential M&A building on Connor Street, within walking distance to everywhere you could hope to visit within this exciting Brisbane suburb. 

We are  just a stone's throw away from the  upmarket James Street Precinct, which offers unforgettable wining and dining experiences within renowned and quaint little cafes, restaurants, and bars; shopping havens of boutique clothing stores and a real relaxed and happy vibe from the locals and travellers that keep Fortitude Valley feeling very different from the fast-paced, city-atmosphere of the Brisbane CBD.

Come and enjoy your holiday within your choice of our select, modern and very comfortable apartments that we offer for stays from 2 nights right up to several months! Unfortunately, we don’t offer permanent leasing.

Car parking for one vehicle is provided free of charge - if you do require another carpark we may be able to arrange this at an extra $25 weekly charge, provided we have the availability to do so. Visitors can make use of the Secure Parking below us, where the rates for visitor parking are displayed at the entrance boom gate.

We offer unlimited and free Wifi (100Mbps typical evening speeds) with a private Netflix account ready to be used!

Our guests are welcome to make use of the Pool and BBQ Recreational deck on Level 3 - please let me know if you would like to use some pool towels! 

If you have a pet that you just can’t leave behind, don’t fret - you may be able to bring your bundle of fluffy joy with you! A select few of our apartments are 'small dog' friendly, providing some requirements are met - please ask me about these requirements if you would like to know more! 

I am very much a ‘dog person’ and believe in giving back to those who need it most. $2 from every guest stay is donated to Bali Animal Welfare Association to help fund the incredible work the BAWA team do, rescuing and protecting the genetically unique Bali Dog and being the saviour to all animals in need, in Bali. I sell not-for-profit jewellery by BAWA’s founder Janice Girardi which 100% of the proceeds go straight to BAWA - get in touch if you would like to see the range while you are here! 

You can reach me on my mobile 24/7 and I am always more than happy to assist our guests where possible to make their stay enjoyable and fondly remembered. I live in the building too, and am never far away should you need my help at all throughout your stay.

I hope to welcome you soon!

Kindest regards,
Coby Lee Beel  |   Apartments on Connor

Rosalie Village with its boutique shops, French patisserie and cafes, convenience store, deli and butcher is an almost flat 5 minute walk away. Suncorp Stadium (Lang Park) takes about 25 minutes to walk or a 3 minute Uber. Brisbane City, Southbank Parklands and major hospitals including the Children's are only 10 mins away by car and easy to get to on public transport. The University of Queensland and QUT are 10 mins drive. The closest supermarket (Woolies) is a 12 minute walk (up hill) and a walk further along La Trobe Terrace takes you to Paddington’s main shopping precinct full of boutiques, bars and restaurants. Caxton street and nightlife are less than a 5 minute uber ride.

For kids of all ages the wonderful Frew Park is only a 10 minute walk away and there's a big skate park near Suncorp.

Welcome to Coorparoo, a vibrant and historic suburb nestled just 5.7 kilometers southeast of Brisbane's central business district. With a rich history dating back to its Aboriginal origins and its subsequent settlement in the mid-19th century, Coorparoo offers a unique blend of the past and the present, making it an exciting destination for travelers.

Coorparoo's name is thought to derive from an Aboriginal name for Norman Creek and carries a rich Aboriginal heritage. The Coorparoo clan lived south of the Brisbane River, and the area was known for its frequent corroborees, traditional gatherings featuring music and dance, along the banks of Norman Creek. The suburb continued to grow and flourish after white settlement, with early development spurred on by the construction of the bridge at Stanley Street and the extension of the tramway to Buranda in the late 19th century​​.

With a rich history dating back to its Aboriginal origins and its subsequent settlement in the mid-19th century, Coorparoo offers a unique blend of the past and the present, making it an exciting destination for travelers.

Coorparoo's name is thought to derive from an Aboriginal name for Norman Creek and carries a rich Aboriginal heritage. The Coorparoo clan lived south of the Brisbane River, and the area was known for its frequent corroborees, traditional gatherings featuring music and dance, along the banks of Norman Creek. The suburb continued to grow and flourish after white settlement, with early development spurred on by the construction of the bridge at Stanley Street and the extension of the tramway to Buranda in the late 19th century​​.

Here you’ll find the Queensland Art Gallery and Gallery of Modern Art (QAGOMA), the Queensland Performing Arts Centre, Queensland Museum and Sciencentre and the State Library of Queensland. South Bank is known for its fine dining with a number of restaurants capturing riverfront views. Book ahead for dinner at OTTO, Popolo or River Quay Fish.

neighborhood_overview:
Welcome to Coorparoo, a vibrant and historic suburb nestled just 5.7 kilometers southeast of Brisbane's central business district. With a rich history dating back to its Aboriginal origins and its subsequent settlement in the mid-19th century, Coorparoo offers a unique blend of the past and the present, making it an exciting destination for travelers.

Coorparoo's name is thought to derive from an Aboriginal name for Norman Creek and carries a rich Aboriginal heritage. The Coorparoo clan lived south of the Brisbane River, and the area was known for its frequent corroborees, traditional gatherings featuring music and dance, along the banks of Norman Creek. The suburb continued to grow and flourish after white settlement, with early development spurred on by the construction of the bridge at Stanley Street and the extension of the tramway to Buranda in the late 19th century​​.

neighborhood_overview:
Welcome to Coorparoo, a vibrant and historic suburb nestled just 5.7 kilometers southeast of Brisbane's central business district. With a rich history dating back to its Aboriginal origins and its subsequent settlement in the mid-19th century, Coorparoo offers a unique blend of the past and the present, making it an exciting destination for travelers.

Coorparoo's name is thought to derive from an Aboriginal name for Norman Creek and carries a rich Aboriginal heritage. The Coorparoo clan lived south of the Brisbane River, and the area was known for its frequent corroborees, traditional gatherings featuring music and dance, along the banks of Norman Creek. The suburb continued to grow and flourish after white settlement, with early development spurred on by the construction of the bridge at Stanley Street and the extension of the tramway to Buranda in the late 19th century​​.

I have stayed in all sorts of accommodations from luxury hotels to a couch in someone's living room. Some of my experiences were absolutely magical while some could be horrifying.

We are  just a stone's throw away from the  upmarket James Street Precinct, which offers unforgettable wining and dining experiences within renowned and quaint little cafes, restaurants, and bars; shopping havens of boutique clothing stores and a real relaxed and happy vibe from the locals and travellers that keep Fortitude Valley feeling very different from the fast-paced, city-atmosphere of the Brisbane CBD.

Come and enjoy your holiday within your choice of our select, modern and very comfortable apartments that we offer for stays from 2 nights right up to several months! Unfortunately, we don’t offer permanent leasing.

Car parking for one vehicle is provided free of charge - if you do require another carpark we may be able to arrange this at an extra $25 weekly charge, provided we have the availability to do so. Our guests are welcome to make use of the Pool and BBQ Recreational deck on Level 3 - please let me know if you would like to use some pool towels!

Coby Lee Beel  |   Apartments on Connor

neighborhood_overview: Fortitude Valley, commonly known as "The Valley," is a vibrant inner-city suburb of Brisbane. Steeped in history, it was named after the ship "Fortitude" that transported convicts in the 1820s. Today, it stands as a cultural hub with a thriving arts, music, and nightlife scene, hosting a plethora of live music venues, art galleries, and theatres. The area is renowned for its diverse shopping experiences, ranging from boutique stores to high-end fashion boutiques, with popular precincts like the Emporium and James Street. Fortitude Valley also offers a wide array of dining options, showcasing global cuisines and trendy restaurants. Connected by a railway station and several bus routes, it remains an accessible locale. With an energetic nightlife, the area hosts events and festivals. Fortitude Valley is an ever-evolving, cosmopolitan destination that caters to diverse interests and lifestyles.

neighborhood_overview:
The Wynnum/Manly/Lota Foreshores extends from the mangrove edge of Elanora Park in Wynnum, south to the tidal mangrove forest at the mouth of Lota Creek. Notable features along the foreshore include Elanora Park, Oyster Point, Greene Park, Pandanus Beach, Wynnum Jetty, Wynnum Wading Pool, Darling Point, Manly Beach, Norfolk Point, Manly Boat Harbour and Fig Tree Point. A ribbon of small parks runs along most of the length of the foreshore interrupted only by the Manly Boat Harbour.

Expansive views of Moreton Bay and its islands are afforded from most locations along the foreshore. Views extend from the Port of Brisbane at Fisherman’s Island, around to St Helena Island, the sandhills of Moreton Island, to Green Island and Stradbroke Island. The Wynnum/Manly/Lota Foreshores is popular for picnics and promenading, walking, cycling, fishing, boating, informal sports and games, swimming, windsurfing and birdwatching.

The Known for its leafy streets, close-knit community, and proximity to the city, The Gap has become one of Brisbane's most sought-after addresses—and for good reason.

neighborhood_overview: Fortitude Valley, commonly known as "The Valley," is a vibrant inner-city suburb of Brisbane. Steeped in history, it was named after the ship "Fortitude" that transported convicts in the 1820s. Today, it stands as a cultural hub with a thriving arts, music, and nightlife scene, hosting a plethora of live music venues, art galleries, and theatres. The area is renowned for its diverse shopping experiences, ranging from boutique stores to high-end fashion boutiques, with popular precincts like the Emporium and James Street. Fortitude Valley also offers a wide array of dining options, showcasing global cuisines and trendy restaurants. Connected by a railway station and several bus routes, it remains an accessible locale. With an energetic nightlife, the area hosts events and festivals. Fortitude Valley is an ever-evolving, cosmopolitan destination that caters to diverse interests and lifestyles.

Coby Lee Beel  |   Apartments on Connor
